assessments.mechanism: Statistical racing: incrementally evaluate candidates and eliminate weak ones as paired evidence becomes sufficient.
assessments.clean_scope: Original evidence is automated configuration of MAX-MIN Ant System on generated TSP-like instances; the exact efficiency ratio is setting-specific.
assessments.o_comparison: O has scoped Candidate evaluation and strategy-change triggers, but no sequential statistical racing/elimination allocator with paired-evidence stopping was found.

assessments.mechanism: Retain diverse solvers and route each instance to a predicted-best solver, with cheap pre-solvers for easy cases.
assessments.clean_scope: SAT solver-selection evidence on benchmark distributions with engineered features; exact speedups should not be generalized outside that setting.
assessments.o_comparison: O explicitly supports heterogeneous routes, candidate applicability by scope, and situation-dependent recursive routing. It does not have a learned per-instance solver portfolio or SATzilla-like runtime predictor, so this is known structurally but unevaluated as the clean candidate.

assessments.mechanism: Decentralized randomized work stealing from busy workers' ready frontier queues.
assessments.clean_scope: Cilk/fully-strict multithreaded computation evidence; gains depend on sufficient parallelism and coarse-enough tasks.
assessments.o_comparison: O permits isolated parallel useful work, but code/content search found no work-stealing scheduler and current main integration is deliberately serialized. No matched research-frontier stealing test was found.

assessments.mechanism: Use optimization plus interpretable explanatory models and explicit hypothesis-breaking interventions so experiments produce transferable knowledge.
assessments.clean_scope: Nature 2024 materials/photostability setting; the ~1.5% space coverage is not a universal speedup.
assessments.o_comparison: O already structures work as falsifiable units, execution, objective evaluation, retained evidence, and explicit falsifiers/strategy review. It does not fit an interpretable mechanism model from experiment streams or test the closed-loop-transfer intervention as described.

assessments.mechanism: Minimize a failure-inducing context by controlled deletion/partition tests until a small reproducer remains.
assessments.clean_scope: Software-debugging evidence; the dramatic Perl reduction is a case result, not an average speedup estimate.
assessments.o_comparison: O records scoped failures and regression fixtures but no delta-debugging/minimal-causal-context search mechanism was found.
